title: Factory Agent-Skills Manifest (RFC-0019 section 3.4)
description: The document served at `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`. Two shapes share this schema, discriminated by `kind`: a `service` manifest (published by PFactory / AIFactory / TFactory / CFactory, describing that one service's identity, installable skills, MCP endpoint and OpenAPI URL) and a `fleet` manifest (published by CFactory at the cockpit host, the union of the four service manifests). The manifest is capability metadata only: it is readable WITHOUT authentication so an agent can enumerate what the Factory can do before it holds a token. It carries no secrets, no tenant data and no work-item state. Companion document: apis/agent-skills-manifest.md.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Additive changes keep this; breaking changes bump it. Consumers MUST ignore unknown fields rather than fail.

kind.description: `service` = one service's own manifest. `fleet` = the CFactory aggregate over the four.

service_body.description: Everything a service manifest carries apart from the envelope (`schema_version`, `kind`). Reused verbatim by each entry of a fleet manifest's `services[]`.

openapi_url.description: Where this service's OpenAPI 3.x document lives. RFC-0019 section 3.3 requires it be readable without auth so an agent can enumerate the REST surface before authenticating.

skills.description: What an agent can do here. Each entry names one capability and exactly one concrete way to invoke it. This list is curated, not a directory dump: an entry MUST correspond to a capability the service genuinely implements.

generated_at.description: When this manifest document was rendered. Used with ETag/Cache-Control for staleness reasoning (see apis/agent-skills-manifest.md).

name.description: Stable machine name, e.g. `aifactory`. Matches the Backstage catalog component name.

version.description: The running service version (not the schema version). An agent uses this plus `generated_at` to decide whether a cached manifest is still good.

role.description: PARR stage this service owns: prepare=PFactory, act=AIFactory, reflect=TFactory, review=CFactory.

description.description: One paragraph: what this service does.

mcp_endpoint.description: How to reach this service's Model Context Protocol server.

transport.description: `stdio` servers are spawned per-process by the client; the HTTP transports are reachable remotely and need `endpoint`.

endpoint.description: Absolute or origin-relative URL of the remote MCP server. Required for the HTTP transports.

command.description: argv used to spawn a `stdio` server, e.g. ["bash", "scripts/start-aifactory-mcp.sh"]. Advisory: the client still supplies its own env.

documentation.description: Human-readable description of the MCP tool surface.

skill.description: One capability, with the single preferred way to invoke it. Programmatic equivalence (RFC-0019 section 3.3) means most skills are reachable over BOTH REST and MCP; the manifest names the preferred route and `openapi_url` / `mcp` let an agent enumerate the rest.

name.description: Stable id, unique within the service. For an installable skill package this is its SKILL.md `name`.

description.description: What the skill does and when to reach for it, in plain prose. This is the field an agent reasons over, so write it for a reader with no prior Factory knowledge.

auth_required.description: Whether invoking this skill needs a credential. The manifest itself is always readable without one; invocation usually is not.

invocation.description: Exactly one concrete call. Discriminated by `kind`.

command.description: The slash command an agent runs once the skill package is installed, e.g. `/handover`.

tool.description: MCP tool name on this service's server, e.g. `task.create`.

path.description: Origin-relative path as it appears in the OpenAPI document, e.g. `/api/tasks/{taskId}/qa-fix`.

install.description: Where the installable skill package lives, for skills shipped as a SKILL.md directory. Absent for capabilities that are pure API/MCP surface.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the skill's SKILL.md, e.g. `.claude/skills/handover/SKILL.md`.

ref.description: Branch/tag/commit to install from. Defaults to the repo default branch.

auth.description: How to authenticate once discovery is done. The manifest and the OpenAPI document are readable without any of this.

manifest.description: Fixed: reading this manifest never requires a credential (RFC-0019 section 3.4). Present so a consumer can assert the guarantee rather than infer it.

schemes.description: Credential types accepted when invoking skills.

fleet_body.description: The CFactory aggregate: the union of the service manifests, served at the cockpit host so one fetch enumerates the whole Factory.

aggregator.description: Which service built this aggregate. CFactory by construction.

services.description: One entry per service manifest folded in. Each entry is a service manifest body plus the URL it was fetched from, so a consumer can always go back to the origin.

manifest_url.description: The origin `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` this entry was copied from.

fetched_at.description: When the aggregator last successfully fetched the origin manifest.

reachable.description: False when the aggregator served a cached copy because the origin was unreachable. Absent means reachable.

url.description: An absolute URL, or a path relative to the manifest's own origin (starting with `/`).
